title: TooLight
description: This is a modpack purely for performance. Nothing special.
body:
This optimizes your game using mods such as ferritecore. Which reduces memory use.

**Credits and Attributions:**
Radium (Fork of lithium for forge) By Asek3
Embeddium (Rubidium) Extra By dima_dencep

INFO:
Starlight:

Starlight can be installed either on the dedicated server or client. It's not required to be installed on both sides. If you have Starlight on the server, clients can use Vanilla/Phosphor/Starlight to connect. If ya have Starlight on the client, you can connect to Vanilla/Phosphor/Starlight servers.

Starlight cannot be installed with Phosphor, they are completely incompatible. Browsing through Starlight's Issue Tracker will show further mod incompatibilities. Starlight is a rather destructive light engine rewrite, so it should be expected to break mods more often.

For more information visit: https://modrinth.com/mod/starlight-forge
